capabilities.name: Conversions API (CAPI)
capabilities.desc: Server events. WA conversation, lead, purchase.
capabilities.notes: For click-to-WhatsApp, attribution key is ctwa_clid delivered on the FIRST inbound message. If it is not persisted at that moment it is lost. Event set reported: LeadSubmitted (not Lead), Purchase, AddToCart, InitiateCheckout, ViewContent; action_source=business_messaging. Reported 7-day attribution window.

evidence.claim: CAPI for Business Messaging exists; needs dataset + WABA id + ctwa_clid; ctwa_clid is per-click and exposed when the user arrives from a CTWA ad.
Accepted event names and the 7-day attribution caveat.
evidence.note: Third-party API docs claiming live verification against Graph v25.0.

capabilities.name: Advanced Matching
capabilities.desc: Email, phone hash. Lift match rate +15-25%.
capabilities.notes: A's '+15-25% match lift' is unsourced and describes the web Pixel/CAPI path. The messaging path attributes by ctwa_clid, so hashing PII adds little there and creates transfer exposure (see K1).

evidence.claim: Messaging-path attribution is keyed on ctwa_clid.
'+15-25%' lift: no source in the artefact, none found.

capabilities.name: Delivery-outcome -> CAPI purchase pipeline
capabilities.desc: A's 'Offline Conversions' product was discontinued May 2025; offline events now go through the unified Conversions API. Re-scoped: courier delivery/COD-collected status -> Purchase event carrying the original ctwa_clid.
capabilities.notes: Feasibility of the API leg is documented; whether Meta optimisation benefits from late (post-delivery) COD signals is OPEN. Window limits: post-delivery events may exceed the reported 7-day attribution window -> measure lag from our own data.

evidence.claim: Offline Conversions API discontinued May 2025; replaced by Conversions API (action_source physical_store / system_generated).
CAPI business-messaging Purchase event with ctwa_clid is the supported path for chat-originated sales.
Optimisation uplift from COD-delivered purchase signals; courier-lag vs attribution window.

capabilities.name: Ad billing instrument
capabilities.desc: A payment method Meta Ads Manager will accept for an Algerian advertiser.
capabilities.notes: Algerian CIB/Edahabia cards are reported as generally rejected for Meta billing; virtual USD cards are the common workaround. FX/regulatory treatment of paying a foreign platform is OPEN -> counsel/bank.

evidence.claim: CIB/Edahabia cards generally rejected by Meta/Google/TikTok billing; convertible-currency cards required.
evidence.note: Trade site + a virtual-card vendor (commercial interest).

evidence.claim: Legal/FX position on funding a foreign ad account from Algeria.

capabilities.name: Local payment rails (CIB/Edahabia via PSP link)
capabilities.desc: External checkout for DOMESTIC cards (SlickPay-class PSPs, SATIM network) triggered from chat as a link; COD remains default. Serves Algerian cardholders only -- NOT a replacement for diaspora payments (see P3).
capabilities.notes: Vendor doc claims ~30-50% lower conversion than COD-only on cold traffic -- single commercial source, treat as hypothesis to measure.

evidence.claim: PSP gateways for CIB/Edahabia exist with API credentials and webhooks.
Conversion trade-off vs COD.

capabilities.name: Courier adapter layer
capabilities.desc: Provider-neutral shipping port: fees by wilaya/commune, parcel create, status, return fee. Adapters: Yalidine family (API ID+token), Ecotrack family, Maystro, ZR Express (UUID territories), Noest.
capabilities.notes: Yalidine API needs a verified business account; commune name mismatch (Arabic vs French spelling) is a known create-time failure. Couriers differ in COD semantics (Yalidine bills delivery fee separately).

evidence.claim: Yalidine Express API (api.yalidine.app/v1): localities, fees, parcel creation, stop-desks; access via API ID+token.
Many Algerian courier APIs are inconsistent or undocumented; unified wrappers exist.

capabilities.name: Data-transfer & residency gate
capabilities.desc: Design-time and run-time check that personal data only reaches providers/regions permitted by a policy table owned by counsel.
capabilities.notes: Law 18-07 as amended by Law 25-11 (2025): express consent; transfers abroad subject to ANPDP rules/authorization. Trade sources disagree on specifics (default local hosting, processing times) -> OPEN; needs Algerian counsel. This is a gate in the architecture, not a legal conclusion.

evidence.claim: Law 18-07 (amended by 25-11, July 2025): consent principle; cross-border transfers regulated and tied to ANPDP authorization.
evidence.note: Law-firm summary; statute text not retrieved.

evidence.claim: Local-hosting default and authorization timelines (single trade-site claims, conflicting wording).

capabilities.name: Consent & purpose ledger
capabilities.desc: Per-contact record of consent, purpose and channel, consulted before any outbound event (CAPI, courier, LLM).
capabilities.notes: Follows from the consent principle; implementation is ours.

evidence.claim: Express prior consent is the core principle of the Algerian regime.

capabilities.name: Canonical event backbone
capabilities.desc: Provider-neutral event model (conversation_started[ctwa_clid], lead_qualified, order_created, confirmed, shipped, delivered, returned, paid). CAPI/analytics/CRM are subscribers.
capabilities.notes: Invariant: persist ctwa_clid at the first inbound webhook, idempotently. Everything in the signal layer depends on this.

evidence.claim: ctwa_clid is delivered with the first inbound message and is required for attribution.

capabilities.name: Cross-border collection rail
capabilities.desc: Accepting payment from buyers abroad (e.g. diaspora with EU cards) and settling to an Algerian business. Needed by artefact B's Diaspora Bridge once native WhatsApp payments (D4) are ruled out.
capabilities.notes: NOT examined. Settlement, FX and foreign-currency regulation for an Algerian merchant are OPEN and potentially restrictive; may require a foreign merchant-of-record structure. Counsel/bank question before any design work.

evidence.claim: No source examined for foreign-card acceptance and settlement into Algeria.

capabilities.notes: Inherited from B, unverified.
